intro.text: A huge, slow, docile crustacean, Roshar's most common beast of burden.

description.text: Their shells hold no nerves, so they can be carved or shaped without harm, and are hard enough to deflect arrows. Asleep, with legs and head pulled in, a chull looks like a boulder. The Reshi paint their chulls' shells in island patterns.
Chulls are slow and rarely aggressive. Less clever than horses, they learn rhythms tapped on their shells with a long reed and associate them with commands, though training them takes a professional.

Chulls are worth more than an average slave and pull everything from wagons to Dalinar's great siege bridges. Their light, tough shell is used for crafts, and their meat is eaten; Herdazians and Unkalaki consider chull head a delicacy.
A chull hatches from an egg as a larva called a chull cremling, then undergoes the First Pupation into an adult, forgetting everything it learned, so it must be trained again.

Adult chulls are massive six-legged crustaceans with thick clawed legs, a stone-like shell, usually red, whip-like antennae and fist-sized black eyes. Their mouths open sideways and can crush rockbuds.
